mapper.sql: select id, issue_no, issue_type, target_type, target_id, target_no, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, status, issue_date, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wm_issue
mapper.insert: insert into wm_issue (issue_no, issue_type, target_type, target_id, target_no, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, status, issue_date, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{issueNo}, #{issueType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetNo}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{status}, #{issueDate}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update wm_issue set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{issueId}
mapper.insert: insert into wm_issue_item (issue_id, item_id2, item_code, item_name, batch_code, quantity, unit, remark) values (#{issueId}, #{itemId2}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{batchCode}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{remark})
